This feels right. Twenty items with “Load more” is a good starting point, and two lines for the title and description gives enough context without letting one bookmark dominate the list. The note preview and Show more/Show less behavior also works well.

The full title and description should remain available when I edit the bookmark, even though they’re shortened in the list. Sorting and filtering the complete result set before showing the first 20 is exactly what I expected. I’m satisfied with these edge cases.
